title: Days Left to File Claim in Disney’s $50,000,000 YouTube TV and DirecTV Settlement
summary:
Disney has reached a $50 million partial settlement in a class action antitrust lawsuit brought by YouTube TV and DirecTV Stream subscribers alleging the company inflated live TV streaming prices.
The post Days Left to File Claim in Disney’s $50,000,000 YouTube TV and DirecTV Settlement appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Disney has agreed to a $50 million partial settlement to resolve a class action antitrust lawsuit. The legal action was brought by subscribers of YouTube TV and DirecTV Stream, who alleged that the media company inflated live television streaming prices. Affected consumers now have a limited time remaining to file their claims to participate in the settlement distribution.
